home.title: The largest community for <badge>modders</badge>
home.description: We bring modders together to build, share, and celebrate what they make.

community.title: What is HytaleModding?
community.description: HytaleModding is the largest community of modders for <link>Hytale</link>. We write docs, guides, and tools for modders of every skill level, and run community events like ModJams, town halls, and more that bring modders together and celebrate what they build.
community.moddability: A big part of Hytale is its moddability, and our goal is to empower modders of all skill levels to create amazing content for the game.
community.welcome: Artists, game developers, or just curious players: everyone's welcome, and nobody needs experience to start.
community.join: Join <link>{count} modders on Discord</link> and start building.

resources.title: <accent>There’s a place to start,</accent> whatever you want to make.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: HytaleModding provides documentation for World Gen, Asset Packs, and Modding Tools. Learn how to create your own mods, explore the API, and get started with modding in Hytale. Start with practical guides, then dive into the API reference for more advanced topics.

wiki.title: HytaleModding Wiki
wiki.description: The HytaleModding Wiki lets modders create a dedicated wiki for their own mod. It's a place to publish guides, document features, and keep everything about the project organized in one spot for the community.

townHalls.title: Town Halls
townHalls.description: We run monthly town halls to keep everyone in the loop, share what we're building, and collect feedback for Hytale directly from the community.
townHalls.archiveDescription: Every town hall we've run, in one place with their recordings and speakers. Check back here for new town halls as they happen, and for reports on what we discussed.
townHalls.empty: Nothing here yet — check back soon.

sponsors.title: Apoie-nos
sponsors.description: O Hytale Modding é um projeto comunitário de código aberto. Para mantermos a comunidade funcionando, temos custos com serviços, servidores e com a hospedagem deste site. Se deseja ajudar o projeto, torne-se um apoiador! Usamos o OpenCollective para que você possa acompanhar com total transparência como os recursos são investidos na nossa comunidade.

press.title: Press Kit
press.description: HytaleModding is the largest community of modders for Hytale. We're an open-source, volunteer-run project that writes documentation, guides, and tools for modders of every skill level.

about.title: Who we are.
about.body1: HytaleModding brings modders together to build, share, and celebrate what they make. We maintain documentation, guides, and tools for modders of every skill level, and everything we produce is open source. We also run community events like ModJams and town halls, and fund community projects through our grant program.
